purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MORNING graded-DCA LIVE execution stream approved 2026-07-09. The morning stream evaluates morning price weakness vs. yesterday's regular-session close on the current 0x-to-5x ladder, tracks a separate morning budget ledger, and writes its own run-state artifacts. It places LIVE Robinhood orders through account 562057042 (the sole execution broker). It is INDEPENDENT of, and never valid scheduled evidence for, the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b); its only afternoon linkage is as prior same-day allocation context for the afternoon top-up guard.

morning_task.name: Morning graded DCA live execution
morning_task.note: LIVE trading. Robinhood account 562057042 is the sole execution broker for both the morning live stream and the afternoon live task; Alpaca stays read-only validation/account context only. The separate 9:45 AM volatility outlier scan (cron cd45e95b) and the 9:00 AM pre-market buying-power/cost analysis (cron b7961407) remain analytics-only and place no orders.

sizing_ladder.name: current_0x_to_5x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: The morning live stream uses the current 0x-to-5x ladder, matching the afternoon ladder in config/sizing_ladder.json. Order amount = base_amount_usd * multiplier.

budget_ledger.separation_note: The morning ledger is a separate session from the afternoon StrategyState / BUDGET_TIERS ledger. Morning live buys never consume or validate the afternoon 3:20/3:45 daily/weekly budget.

artifact_paths.separation_note: The morning stream writes ONLY under the morning root. It never writes into /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/**, never updates latest_scheduled_run.json, and never touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders.

top_up_guard.purpose: Morning live orders/fills are recorded as prior same-day allocation context so the afternoon 3:20/3:45 tasks can offset (top up) rather than duplicate the same-day position. This is the ONLY way morning activity feeds the afternoon stream.
top_up_guard.price_rule: When earlier same-day buys exist for a ticker, the afternoon task only buys if the current price is strictly below the prior-run reference price; otherwise it holds.
top_up_guard.note: morning_desired_amount here refers to the afternoon task's desired amount evaluated against the same-day ladder; morning fills populate prior_same_day_* for that evaluation.

downstream_separation_rules: Afternoon consumers glob only /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/scheduled_runs/** and therefore never traverse the morning root.

A morning run_state has run_type='morning_dca_live', stream='morning', and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; consumers must exclude morning orders/fills from afternoon scheduled-execution evidence, afternoon slippage, afternoon fill counts, afternoon reliability, afternoon watchdog confirmation, and afternoon scheduled cost basis.
The morning stream never updates latest_scheduled_run.json and never writes into afternoon scheduled/manual folders.
Morning orders/fills DO count as prior same-day allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard (see top_up_guard).
